title: Singleton indicator is not orthogonal to constants
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite set $T\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ with $|T|=1$, its binary indicator vector is not orthogonal, under the coordinate dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$, to the subspace consisting of the zero vector and the all-ones vector.
